Home.heading: What do you need today?
Home.subheading: Tradespeople, tutors, beauty and {count}+ more services in every town in Montenegro. Contact them directly, no sign-up.
Home.how1Text: Pick a service and a town. See every business with ratings, prices and opening hours.
Home.how2Text: Browse profiles, price lists, photos and reviews from other customers.
Home.how3Text: Call or message on Viber and WhatsApp directly. No sign-up and no commission.

faq.a: Yes. Searching, viewing profiles and contacting businesses is completely free and doesn't need an account.
Businesses marked “Verified” have had their phone number checked. Other profiles go live right away and our team reviews them within 24 hours.

faq.q: How do I pay for a service?
faq.a: Directly to the business, however you agree. Tražim takes no commission and doesn't handle payments.

faq.q: How do I list my business?
faq.a: Sign-up takes less than 2 minutes: pick your services and the towns you work in, then add your contact details and photos. The basic profile is free.

Prices.methodText: We use the prices businesses enter in their own price lists on Tražim: fixed prices, "from" prices and ranges (for a range we take the midpoint). "On request" and free items are left out. Numbers are refreshed every night. The actual price depends on the job, so always ask for a quote.
